llm_response.reason: DSJ Exchange displays core scam characteristics: (1) Unrealistic returns (guaranteed 60% ROI), (2) ambiguous company licensing claims and untraceable leadership, (3) psychological hooks including urgency, referral bonuses, and fake authority figures, (4) ambiguous or unavailable withdrawal processes with hidden fees, (5) widespread, persistent multi-domain pattern typical of crypto scam syndicates. Multiple community warnings, absence of genuine ASIC or SEC license records, and direct victim complaints strongly confirm the site is an organized investment/cryptocurrency scam.
